title: Nonzero-charge anchored generator compatibility for the geometric strip

parents.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned researcher-owned extension. It does not edit, supersede or retroactively complete PAH-001, PAH-OMC-001, PAH-OMC-003 or PAH-OMC-004.

exact_scope.carrier_family: The PAH-OMC-004 two-row anchored strip G_n, with the first square already split and every later frontier square split on the next refinement; levels n>=1 are compared.
exact_scope.anchors: a=(0,0) is the retained aperture observable anchor; O and C are the declared strip anchors and no nontrivial anchor automorphism is used.
exact_scope.state_domain: The audited finite states have one radial occupation quantum placed at exactly one of the four anchor-patch vertices a,b,c,d, zero radial occupation on remote vertices, all four patch phases in Z_2, all five patch links in Z_2, and all remote coordinates fixed to the neutral extension values. Thus Q=1 is genuinely nonzero while the state count is finite and explicit.
exact_scope.functional: Evaluate exactly the displayed PAH-001 F_rho: aperture onsite and matter polynomial, aperture edge stiffness, covariant matter edge term, and plaquette Wilson term. No term or coupling is added.
exact_scope.moves: Use the PAH-001 aperture root AP(a,+/-) and its unchanged midpoint rate c=m exp(-beta DeltaF/2). Phase, radial-transfer and link roots preserve the anchor aperture observable and therefore contribute zero to the selected cylinder generator row.
exact_scope.observable: The common cylinder is every bounded function of the anchor aperture s_a; the audit uses the basis 1, s_a and the indicator 1_{j_a=1}. These functions are gauge invariant and anchor preserving.
exact_scope.normalization: Finite counting-measure Gibbs midpoint rates exactly as in PAH-001; no averaging over dropped variables is used.
exact_scope.limit: No cutoff, volume, lattice, continuum, phase, beta or observation limit is taken. n is only a finite geometric refinement label.

maps.geometric_inclusion: J_(n,m), n<m and n>=1, retains every old vertex, edge, aperture, phase, radial occupation and link coordinate by its geometric ID; new vertices and edges are appended with neutral aperture, zero radial occupation and neutral Z_2 labels. Since the old state already has Q=1, J preserves Q.
maps.local_restriction: r_a records the four patch apertures, four patch matter occupations and phases, and five patch links incident to a. The anchor interaction closure is C_a={a,b,c,d; h00,v0,d0,h01,v1; the two split faces}.
maps.observable_lift: I_(n,m)f is the same coordinate cylinder f(s_a) on both finite state spaces; it is not a conditional expectation and is defined on every fine state.
maps.root_correspondence: Only AP(a,+/-) can change I_(n,m)f. Every other PAH root is retained in the fine generator but has zero observable increment. AP(a,+/-) has the same admissibility, mobility and affected-term support at every n>=1.

compatibility_proposition.statement: For n,m>=1, any two valid states with identical r_a data have identical DeltaF, mobility, and observable increment for AP(a,+/-). Consequently (L_m I_(n,m)f)(x_m)=(I_(n,m)L_n f)(x_n) for every bounded anchor-aperture cylinder f whenever r_a(x_m)=r_a(x_n). In particular, the neutral inclusion J_(n,m) gives exact row equality on the audited Q=1 states.
proof_obligations: The AP(a,+/-) energy difference is the sum of exactly one aperture onsite term, the three incident edge terms h00,v0,d0 and the two split face terms; every other PAH term has support disjoint from a and cancels.
The n>=1 strip incidence signature of C_a is independent of n, so the displayed PAH functional gives the same local formula at every compared level.
The aperture mobility is a function only of s_a before and after, and all non-aperture roots have zero increment on f(s_a).
The injection preserves Q=1 and the local coordinates, so it is a genuine state correspondence for the audited nonzero-charge fixture.
compatibility_proposition.cumulative_consequence: For this anchor cylinder, the geometric tail defect is exactly zero after the first split boundary; no supremum over all cylinders or volume-uniform estimate is asserted.

finite_acceptance.primary: Enumerate every fixture state and compute full PAH energy on G_1 and its neutral inclusion in G_2; compare the exact generator row and support decomposition.
finite_acceptance.independent: Rebuild the carrier, matter amplitudes, covariant edge terms, Wilson faces and midpoint rows from direct formulas without importing the primary module.
finite_acceptance.hostile: Reject source drift, Q=0 substitution, colour-only topology, omitted matter terms, rate fitting, wrong mobility, frontier-face leakage and charge-changing embeddings.
finite_acceptance.lean: Cross-check the nonzero charge, state-count factorization, stable incidence closure, exact mobility and non-promotion firewall. Lean is a finite arithmetic cross-check, not a global theorem formalization.

known_boundaries.local_only: The proposition covers the anchor-aperture cylinder. It does not cover arbitrary matter, link or radial cylinders whose roots can see a changing frontier.
known_boundaries.fixture_only: Q=1, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1 and the displayed unit couplings are a finite researcher fixture. No parameter-uniform theorem is claimed.
known_boundaries.no_global_uniformity: Exact local row equality does not establish a global common algebra, source-authorized uniform interaction estimate, infinite-volume generator, or ordered limit.
known_boundaries.no_physics: The Markov time and Q=1 sector are not quantum time, a physical sector, a vacuum, Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, a continuum or a mass gap.
